concerns.text: The plan states it will “ingest a verified open‑source NetFlow dataset (keys‑i/netFlow) as a substitute for CTU‑13”. FR‑001 explicitly requires ingestion of the CTU‑13 dataset; substituting a different dataset violates the functional requirement and makes the results incomparable to the original research question.

The plan describes “deterministic stratified subsampling preserving the anomaly proportion” when node count exceeds 5,000. FR‑002 mandates that if the graph exceeds the node limit, the system MUST subsample by **retaining the largest connected component**. Using stratified sampling deviates from the required method and may affect reproducibility and graph fidelity.
